outcome_sought: Refund the difference between the standard variable rate and the agreed fixed rate for September and October (about £410), and backdate the new product to 1 September 2026.
rationale: A broker with the customer's signed authority complains about a late product switch, so CP-1.2 applies and Mortgage Servicing owns it. The broker says the switch went in on 4 Aug but the mortgage system shows 19 Aug, so CP-4.2 means the pack must record both versions and not choose. The mortgage checklist items are all present, but no one has contacted the customer or told her about the handover.
